item.title: 'All-Gong Youth' Event with Jang Dong-hyuk in Attendance... A Gathering Place for Yoon Again Supporters and Election Fraud Theorists (장동혁 참석 ‘올공 청년’ 행사…윤어게인·부정선거론자 집합소)
item.description:
Youths who participated in the 'Olympic Park (All-Gong) Handball Stadium Vote Counting Station Blockade Protest' attended a National Assembly forum hosted by a People Power Party lawmaker on the 29th, arguing for a re-election in the June 3 local elections and urging People Power Party lawmakers to join their protest. The forum, attended by Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, included individuals who have advocated election fraud theories or displayed a 'Yoon (Suk-yeol) Again' tendency. (‘올림픽공원(올공) 핸드볼경기장 개표소 봉쇄 시위’에 참석한 청년들이 29일 국민의힘 의원이 주최한 국회 토론회에서 6·3 지방선거 재선거를 주장하며 국민의힘 의원들의 시위 동참을 촉구했다. 장동혁 대표가 참석한 토론회에는 부정선거론을 주장하거나 ‘윤(석열) 어게인’ 성향을 드러내온 인사들이 동참했다.)

At the forum titled 'All-Gong Youth Speak,' hosted by Rep. Choi Su-jin at the National Assembly Members' Office Building, presenters including a YouTuber, a volunteer from the Olympic Park protest, and a participant in the Incheon Suffrage Protection Rally argued for a 're-election,' claiming the need to reclaim voting rights. They shared opinions on topics such as 'the path conservatives, as seen by youth, should take through the June 3 local elections.' (이날 국회 의원회관에서 최수진 의원 주최로 열린 ‘올공 청년들은 말한다’ 토론회에선 발제자로 나선 유튜버, 올림픽공원 시위 자원봉사자, 인천 참정권 수호집회 참석자들이 참정권을 되찾아야 한다며 ‘재선거’를 주장했다. 이들은 ‘6·3 지방선거를 통해 청년들이 바라보는 보수가 나아가야 할 길’ 등을 주제로 의견을 나눴다.)

YouTuber Park Ki-tae, who broadcasts the protest site, stated, "The public is not tired of this prolonged situation but rather exhausted by shameless politicians who do not heed the people's voices," and claimed, "Those who deny election fraud must now be the criminals, accomplices." He has publicly called for the release of former President Yoon Suk-yeol in front of the Seoul Central District Court via his YouTube channel, shouting "The impeachment of former President Yoon is invalid." (시위 현장을 중계하는 유튜버 박기태씨는 “국민은 이 사태가 길어져 피로한 것이 아니라 국민의 목소리를 귀담아듣지 않는 파렴치한 정치인들로 인해 피로감을 느끼는 것”이라며 “부정선거를 부정하는 자가 이제는 범인 아니겠나. 공범”이라고 주장했다. 그는 서울중앙지법 앞에서 윤석열 전 대통령 석방 운동을 유튜브 채널을 통해 공개하며 “윤 전 대통령 탄핵 무효”를 외쳐온 이다.)

YouTuber Lee Seung-hee said, "I am concerned that many young people are increasingly leaving (Olympic Park) as they face exclusion and censorship," and urged, "Please do not stop at a recount; push through to achieve a re-election." Lee has uploaded videos on his YouTube channel containing content that disparages the Sewol Ferry disaster and sends supportive messages to former President Yoon. (유튜버 이승희씨는 “배척되고 검열되기 시작하면서 (올림픽공원을) 점점 떠나는 청년이 많이 생기는 상황이 우려된다”며 “절대 재검표에서 멈추지 말고 재선거까지 쟁취해 나가시길 바란다”고 했다. 이씨는 세월호 참사 폄훼, 윤 전 대통령 응원 메시지 등이 담긴 동영상을 유튜브 채널에 공개해왔다.)

Lee Seong-jae, a participant in the rally condemning the infringement of voting rights in Incheon, said, "Election fraud has not only erupted in Seoul but across the country—how much attention are district lawmakers paying to this?" adding, "No one except Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is touring the nation," and "Shouldn't they at least raise their voices together or show it through actions?" Olympic Park volunteer Jo Min-jun stated, "I've come this far fighting against election fraud for two years," and said, "If you show us that you are fighting more against the (Democratic) Party, I can fight for one or two years in the scorching sun." <<> At the event, in addition to Representative Jang, lawmakers Park Jun-tae, Lee Sang-hwi, and Im Jong-deuk were present, along with Kyonggi University Professor Lee Soo-jeong, the chairperson of the People Power Party's Suwon Jeong district party committee. Before the discussion began, Representative Jang said to the attendees, "Since I see most of you at Olympic Park every day, it's more welcoming. I was at All-Gong last night as well," and added, "The target of the special counsel investigation must clearly include without controversy the computer manipulation." (인천 참정권 침해 규탄 집회에 참여하고 있는 이성재씨는 “부정선거는 서울에서만 터진 것이 아니라 전국에서 불거졌는데 지역구 의원들은 얼마나 신경 쓰고 있느냐”며 “장동혁 대표 말고 전국을 순회하는 사람은 없다”, “최소한 목소리를 같이 내주거나 행동으로 보여줘야 하는 것 아닌가”라고 했다. 올림픽공원 자원봉사자 조민준씨는 “2년 전부터 부정선거와 싸우면서 이 자리까지 왔다”며 “(더불어)민주당과 더 싸워주시는 모습을 보여주시면 저는 땡볕에서 1년이고 2년이고 충분히 싸울 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Kim Hae-jeong Reporter sea@hani.co.kr (이날 행사에는 장 대표를 비롯해 박준태·이상휘·임종득 의원, 국민의힘 수원정 당협위원장인 이수정 경기대 교수 등이 자리했다. 장 대표는 토론 시작에 앞서 참석자들을 향해 “대부분 매일 올림픽공원에서 뵙고 있는 분들이라 더 반갑다. 어젯밤에도 올공에 갔다”며 “특검법의 수사 대상, 논란의 여지 없이 전산조작이 포함돼야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae on Jeong Seong-ho’s 'Public Resignation': "He Should Serve Until the Launch and Stabilization of the Prosecution Service" (청와대, ‘공개 사의’ 정성호에 “공소청 출범·안착까지 역할해야”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae stated that Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho, who publicly expressed his intention to resign, needs to continue his role until the prosecution reform is concluded. (청와대가 공개적으로 사의를 표명한 정성호 법무부 장관의 거취와 관련해 검찰개혁 작업을 매듭지을 때까지 역할을 하는 것이 필요하다는 입장을 밝혔다.)

Chief Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo said in an interview on MBC Radio’s “Kim Jong-bae’s Focus” on the 29th, “Minister Jeong has not officially expressed his resignation,” adding, “Prosecution reform is ongoing, and the Prosecution Service and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office are set to launch in October. I believe the minister in charge should serve until these issues are resolved and the system is stabilized.” Chief Hong further stated, “I do not expect an immediate personnel reshuffle.” Minister Jeong had previously indicated his intention to step down on the 27th during a session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, saying, “New wine must be put into new wineskins.” <<> Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Sung Ki-hong also appeared on SBS’s “Joo Young-jin’s News Briefing” the same day and added, “Public office is not a position where you can serve or resign just because you want to. Considering various factors, Minister Jeong will likely think about it, and the situation will unfold accordingly.” <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 29일 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’과 한 인터뷰에서 “(정 장관이) 사의를 공식적으로 표명하신 건 없다”며 “검찰개혁이 진행되고 있고, 공소청과 중대범죄수사청이 10월에 출범해야 되는데 주무부처 장관이 이 문제를 정리하고 제도적으로 안착할 때까지는 역할을 해야 되는 것 아닌가 생각한다”고 말했다. 홍 수석은 그러면서 “당장에 인사 개편은 하지 않을 것으로 본다”고 말했다. 정 장관은 지난 27일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에 출석해 “새 술은 새 부대에 담아야 한다”며 장관직에서 물러나겠다는 의사를 밝힌 바 있다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Leadership Candidates Unite: "Unrealistic to Extend President's Term via Constitutional Amendment" – Eyes on Election Impact (민주 당권주자들 “연임 개헌 비현실적” 한목소리…판세 파장에 촉각)
item.description:
Candidates running for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea are closely watching how remarks by National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, who stated that "a constitutional amendment to allow a sitting president to serve a second term is a choice for the people," will affect the electoral landscape. (더불어민주당 당권 주자들이 “현직 대통령 연임 개헌은 국민의 선택”이라고 한 조정식 국회의원의 발언이 판세에 미칠 영향에 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다.)

Candidates Song Young-gil, Chung Cheong-rae, and Kim Min-seok (in order of ballot numbers) said on the 29th that it is impossible under the Constitution for a sitting president to serve a second term. Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution stipulates that any constitutional amendment to extend or change the term of the president shall have no effect on the president in office at the time of the proposal. (송영길·정청래·김민석 후보(기호순)는 29일 헌법상 현직 대통령 연임은 불가능하다고 말했다. 헌법 제128조 2항은 대통령의 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위한 헌법개정은 그 헌법개정 제안 당시 대통령에 대해 효력이 없다고 돼 있다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil, in an interview with MBC, criticized the remarks, saying, "Changing Article 128 is difficult to gain public consent, and it would require the approval of over 200 members in the National Assembly, which is objectively impossible. Speaker Cho's remarks are open to misunderstanding. The statement itself is inappropriate." (송영길 후보는 문화방송(MBC) 인터뷰에서 “(헌법 128조를 바꾼다는 건) 국민적 동의를 받기 어렵고, 국회에서 200명 이상의 동의가 있어야 하는데 객관적으로도 불가능하다”며 “조 의장의 발언은 오해의 소지가 있다. 발언 자체가 적절치 않다”고 비판했다.)

Candidate Chung Cheong-rae also said on CBS Radio, "If Speaker Cho had clearly stated that it is impossible under Article 128 of the Constitution, it would have been neatly resolved. He said in principle that he would follow the people's will, but he probably didn't expect it to escalate like this." He added, "It seems Speaker Cho was caught by reporters." On Facebook, Chung wrote, "I suggest Speaker Cho clarify his position again and consider apologizing if necessary." (정청래 후보도 시비에스(CBS) 라디오에서 “(조 의장이) 헌법 128조상 불가능한 일이라고 얘기했으면 깔끔하게 정리됐을 것”이라며 “원론적으로 국민들의 뜻을 따르겠다고 얘기한 건데, 이렇게 비화될 줄 몰랐을 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “조 의장이 기자들에게 낚인 것 같다”고 했다. 정 후보는 페이스북에도 “조 의장이 다시 한번 해명하고 필요하면 사과도 고려해보심이 어떤가”라고 적었다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok said on Facebook, "A constitutional amendment to allow a sitting president to serve a second term is unrealistic. It is constitutionally impossible, and the president has repeatedly confirmed this, as have the National Assembly Speaker, the chief of staff, and the senior presidential secretary for political affairs. The speaker of the remarks (Speaker Cho) said it was a misunderstanding, and it is neither right nor necessary to amplify an unexpected issue while the president is on an overseas trip." (김민석 후보는 페이스북에 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌은 비현실적”이라며 “헌법상 불가하고, 대통령께서도 누차 확인하셨고, 국회의장도, 비서실장도, 정무수석도 확인했다. 발언 당사자(조 의장)가 오해라 했고, 대통령께선 해외순방 중 난데없을 쟁점을 더 키우는 것은 옳지도 필요하지도 않다”고 말했다.)

Within the Democratic Party, there is a keen interest in how the controversy over "extending a sitting president's term via constitutional amendment" will affect the party convention, which is 19 days away. One lawmaker serving multiple terms said, "There are stories that author Yoo Si-min is criticizing President Lee Jae-myung out of concern that if he is not stopped now, it could lead to issues like a second term or withdrawal of indictment. This inevitably affects the party convention," viewing it as an unfavorable topic for Candidate Kim. Online, comments by Candidate Kim at a state affairs briefing in Muan, South Jeolla Province, on December 20 of last year are being revisited, where he said, "These days, some people say, 'Five years (of the Lee Jae-myung government) is too short' and 'We wish he could do more.'" In response, a lawmaker supporting Kim said, "He has already stated a clear position, and making malicious claims for electoral advantage is itself an act of misconduct." (민주당 안에서는 ‘현직 대통령 연임 개헌’ 논란이 19일을 남겨둔 전당대회에 어떤 영향을 미칠지 예의주시하는 분위기다. 한 다선 의원은 “유시민 작가가 지금 이재명 대통령을 막지 않으면 연임이나 공소취소 등으로 번져나갈 수 있다는 우려로 이 대통령을 비판한다는 얘기가 있다. 전대에도 영향을 미칠 수밖에 없다”며 김 후보에게 유리하지 않은 소재가 될 것이라고 봤다. 온라인에서는 김 후보가 지난해 12월20일 전남 무안에서 열린 국정설명회에서 “요새는 사람들이 ‘(이재명 정부) 5년이 너무 짧다’ ‘더 했으면 좋겠다’고 하는 분들도 있다”고 한 발언이 회자되고 있다. 이에 김 후보를 돕는 한 의원은 “이미 명확한 입장을 밝혔는데 선거 유불리를 위해 악의적으로 주장하는 것이야말로 해당 행위”라고 했다.)

Some view that since Speaker Cho, the presidential office, and the party have all stated that "a constitutional amendment for a sitting president to serve a second term is impossible," the issue will no longer be a point of contention. On the same day, at the presidential office, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo, and Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Sung Ki-hong all denied the possibility of a constitutional amendment for a presidential second term. A lawmaker serving a second term said, "With the presidential chief of staff and senior secretaries stepping in to manage the issue, I think the controversy will soon subside." (이미 조 의장을 포함해 청와대와 당이 모두 ‘현직 대통령 연임 개헌 불가’ 태도를 밝혔기 때문에 더는 쟁점이 되지 않을 것이라고 보는 시각도 있다. 이날 청와대에서는 강훈식 비서실장과 홍익표 정무수석, 성기홍 홍보소통수석이 모두 나서 대통령 연임 개헌 가능성을 부인했다. 한 재선 의원은 “청와대 비서실장과 수석들까지 진화에 나섰는데 곧 논란이 수그러들 거라 본다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker’s Unconstitutional Remarks on ‘Sitting President’s Reelection’ Dampen Constitutional Amendment Momentum (‘현직 대통령 연임’ 국회의장의 위헌적 발언, 개헌 동력에 찬물)
item.description:
The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae and the ruling Democratic Party of Korea have scrambled to contain the controversy sparked by National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s remarks on “amending the constitution to allow a sitting president’s reelection,” stating it is “impossible under the current Constitution.” However, observers worry that this may do little to ease the distrust of the main opposition People Power Party, which has been reluctant to discuss constitutional amendments under the pretext of concerns over President Lee Jae-myung’s potential reelection, potentially causing the momentum for constitutional reform to rapidly fade. <<> Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Hoon-sik told reporters at Cheong Wa Dae on the morning of the 29th that President Lee, regarding reelection, has said since before the presidential election as a candidate, and continues to state, that “our constitutional system does not allow (constitutional amendments for a sitting president’s reelection), the public will not easily tolerate it, and it is realistically impossible.” Kang added, “Speaker Woo has also explained himself again, and the President has said it is impossible, yet (the opposition) is dragging this into a political debate, and I express strong regret over this.” Chief Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo also said in an interview with MBC Radio’s “Kim Jong-bae’s Focus” that “the President has also stated multiple times that ‘a constitutional amendment for reelection is not possible’ and ‘it is impossible under the current Constitution,’” adding that “there are claims, like a conspiracy theory, that (Speaker Woo) communicated with Cheong Wa Dae, but that is absolutely not true.” <<> In the afternoon, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Sung Ki-hong appeared on SBS’s “Joo Young-jin’s News Briefing” and stated, “A constitutional amendment to extend a sitting president’s term is impossible under constitutional provisions and is unrealistic. Would the public accept it?” He added, “Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution (which stipulates that a president in office at the time a proposal for a constitutional amendment to extend the presidential term or allow reelection is made is not eligible for such a change) is a historical consensus we must uphold.” <<> The day before, Speaker Woo sparked a major uproar by saying “the issue of amending the constitution for a sitting president is ultimately a matter of the people’s choice,” which was interpreted as not ruling out the possibility of President Lee’s reelection through a constitutional amendment. This led top Cheong Wa Dae aides to intervene en masse to contain the fallout. <<> Speaker Woo also posted on Facebook late the previous night, clarifying, “A sitting president’s reelection is not a subject for constitutional amendment discussions.” He added, “My answer at the press conference explained the basic procedure, that for a constitutional amendment—including restructuring the power structure—to happen, it requires consensus among political actors and the people’s choice. I regret that it caused misunderstanding and controversy contrary to my intention.” <<> The ruling party also moved to block the controversy. Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the Democratic Party, Representative Han Byung-do, said at a party Supreme Council meeting, “Speaker Woo has also made clear that Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution must be respected, and that a sitting president’s reelection is not a subject for future constitutional amendment discussions. Yet the People Power Party’s response is absurd. They are launching a full-scale political offensive, treating the president’s reelection as a foregone conclusion, but it amounts to nothing more than baseless, unreasonable claims. I call on them to stop immediately.” <<> Although the party and the presidential office made a concerted effort to manage the fallout from Speaker Woo’s remarks, concerns are rising within the Democratic Party that a constitutional amendment during this administration is now virtually impossible. This is because it has given the People Power Party, which already harbored strong suspicions that “constitutional amendment = a means for President Lee’s reelection,” a reason to oppose it. A constitutional amendment requires approval from more than two-thirds (200 seats) of the total National Assembly members. A Democratic Party lawmaker told The Hankyoreh, “This is an unprecedented situation where the National Assembly Speaker, of all people, has muddled the very first step of the constitutional amendment process.” Another lawmaker said, “Public suspicion over reelection was already a stumbling block, making it difficult to push for a constitutional amendment. The National Assembly Speaker has now fanned the flames of that suspicion.” People Power Party leader Chang Dong-hyuk held a press conference and said, “I hope President Lee will clearly declare to the people that ‘there will be no reelection.’ Those five words would end all controversy in an instant.” <<> Experts say that President Lee must make a public statement and Speaker Woo must apologize to the nation to resolve the controversy and revive the possibility of a constitutional amendment. Kim Yoon-cheol, a professor at Kyung Hee University’s Humanitas College, said, “The President must make his stance that a constitutional amendment for reelection is out of the question clearer than now for the constitutional amendment discussion to barely open in the future. Speaker Woo should apologize to the nation.” Han Sang-hee, a professor at Konkuk University’s Law School, also said, “President Lee must personally state that he will faithfully uphold the Constitution and never even dreamed of reelection. Speaker Woo bears a heavy responsibility for throwing the constitutional amendment debate into a political vortex instead.” <<> Shim Woo-sam, reporter wu32@hani.co.kr Choi Ha-yan, reporter chy@hani.co.kr (청와대와 더불어민주당이 조정식 국회의장의 ‘현직 대통령 연임 개헌론’ 관련 발언 논란에 대해 “현행 헌법상 불가능하다”며 일제히 수습에 나섰다. 그러나 이재명 대통령 연임 가능성을 구실 삼아 개헌 논의에 소극적이었던 국민의힘의 불신을 해소하기는 어려워 보여, 개헌 동력이 급격히 사그라들 것이라는 우려가 제기된다.)

item.title: Bills to Abolish Supplementary Investigative Powers and Shorten Fast-Track to Be Submitted to Plenary Session Tomorrow (‘보완수사권 폐지·패스트트랙 단축’ 법안 내일 본회의 상정)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea will submit to the plenary session on the 30th a revised Criminal Procedure Act that entirely abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers, along with a revised National Assembly Act that shortens the review period for fast-track bills. The People Power Party, opposing both bills, has vowed to block them through a filibuster (unlimited debate), escalating the ruling-opposition conflict to a peak. (더불어민주당이 검사 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 담은 형사소송법 개정안과 신속처리안건(패스트트랙)의 심사 기간을 단축하는 국회법 개정안을 30일 본회의에 상정한다. 두 법안에 반대하는 국민의힘은 필리버스터(무제한 토론)로 저지하겠다고 나서며 여야 갈등이 최고조로 치닫고 있다.)

On the 29th, the Democratic Party convened a full meeting of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee and passed the revised Criminal Procedure Act, which had previously cleared the first subcommittee on bill review the day before. Lawmakers from the People Power Party, who opposed the bill, collectively walked out before the vote. Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo stated, "This is a historic day when the disgraceful prosecution fades into the annals of history." Kim Seung-won, the Democratic Party's secretary on the committee, said, "I want to call this revised Criminal Procedure Act the 'Criminal Justice Normalization Act,'" and added, "I condemn the People Power Party for not participating in the discussion process." <<> Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee submitted a request for a bill coordination committee to block the bill's passage, but the committee, dominated by the ruling bloc, referred it to the full meeting without modification. People Power Party secretary Park Hyung-soo objected, calling it "a bill for deterioration, not revision." <<> The revised National Assembly Act, which shortens the fast-track review period from a maximum of 330 days—180 days in standing committees and 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee—to 60 days in standing committees and 30 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, also passed through the House Steering Committee led by the ruling party on this day and is scheduled to be submitted together to the plenary session on the 30th. <<> The People Power Party called it "a declaration of war to reproduce the ruling party's parliamentary violence," and plans to block the passage of both bills through a filibuster in the plenary session. If the ruling bloc, including the Democratic Party, takes steps to end the filibuster and passes the two bills, the revised Criminal Procedure Act is expected to be approved on the 31st, and the revised National Assembly Act during a subsequent extraordinary session. <<> Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 민주당은 29일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의를 열고 전날 법안심사 1소위원회를 통과한 형사소송법 개정안을 의결했다. 법안에 반대하는 국민의힘 의원들은 표결 전 단체 퇴장했다. 서영교 법사위원장은 “오욕의 검찰이 역사의 뒤안길로 사라진 역사적인 날”이라고 말했다. 민주당 법사위 간사인 김승원 의원은 “저는 이번 형소법 개정안을 형사사법 정상화법으로 부르고 싶다”며 “(논의 과정에 참여하지 않은) 국민의힘을 규탄한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: 'KFA Hearing' to be Held on the 30th... Chung Mong-gyu and Hong Myung-bo to Appear as Witnesses, Lee Im-saeng Absent (‘축구협회 청문회’ 30일 개최…정몽규·홍명보 증인 출석, 이임생 불출석)
item.description:
A National Assembly hearing on the Korea Football Association (KFA), which has sparked controversy over its unilateral operations and the appointment of the national team coach, will be held on the 30th. (독단적 운영과 국가대표팀 감독 선임 의혹으로 논란이 된 대한축구협회에 대한 국회 청문회가 30일 열린다.)

The National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee will convene the hearing at 10 a.m. that day to address issues related to the KFA. The hearing is expected to delve into the overall allegations of the KFA's arbitrary management and the selection processes for former men's national football team coaches Hong Myung-bo and Jürgen Klinsmann. (국회 문화체육관광위원회는 이날 오전 10시 대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회를 개최한다. 이번 청문회에서는 축구협회의 독단적 운영 의혹 전반에 대한 진상 규명과 홍명보, 위르겐 클리스만 전 남자 축구 국가대표팀 감독의 선임 과정 등에 대한 의혹 등이 다뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

Witnesses scheduled to appear include former KFA President Chung Mong-gyu, former coach Hong Myung-bo, former National Team Performance Enhancement Committee Chairman Chung Hae-sung, KFA Vice President Lee Yong-soo, KFA Executive Director Kim Seung-hee, KFA Vice President Kim Byung-ji, and former KFA Vice President Han Jun-hee. Former KFA Technical Director Lee Im-saeng was also selected as a witness but submitted a notice of absence, citing "club training schedules." (청문회에는 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장과 홍 전 감독, 정해성 전 국가대표 전력강화위원장, 이용수 대한축구협회 부회장, 김승희 대한축구협회 전무이사, 김병지 대한축구협회 부회장, 한준희 전 대한축구협회 부회장 등이 증인으로 출석한다. 이임생 전 대한축구협회기술총괄이사는 증인으로 채택됐으나 ‘구단 훈련 일정’을 이유로 불출석 사유서를 제출했다.)

References include Korean Sport & Olympic Committee President Yoo Seung-min and K-Football Innovation Committee Co-Chairman Park Ji-sung, but Park has indicated he will not attend. K-Football Innovation Committee members Park Joo-ho and Lee Young-pyo were also named as references but submitted notices of absence. (참고인으로 유승민 대한체육회장, 박지성 케이(K)-축구 혁신위원회 공동위원장 등이 채택됐으나, 박 위원장은 불출석 의사를 밝혔다. 박주호·이영표 케이-축구 혁신위원회 위원도 참고인으로 채택됐으나 불출석 사유서를 제출했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Disputed Right to Cancel Prosecution in Special Counsel Bill ... Song Young-gil: "Why Now, Before Elections?" Jung Cheong-rae: "No Problem" (조작기소 특검 ‘공소취소 권한’…송영길 “선거 앞 굳이” 정청래 “문제 없다”)
item.description:
Candidates Song Young-gil, Jung Cheong-rae, and Kim Min-seok (in order of party registration number) running in the Democratic Party's August 17 national convention leadership election expressed differing views on the issue of granting a right to cancel prosecution under the "fabricated prosecution" special counsel bill, which the Democratic Party sought to push forward in April but delayed until after local elections. <<> During the first televised debate for party leadership candidates held at MBC in Mapo-gu, Seoul, on the 29th, candidate Song was asked a common question from the moderator about the "fabricated prosecution" special counsel bill, which effectively grants the right to vacate an indictment. He directed his response at candidate Jung, stating, "Was it really necessary to submit it in April, ahead of the election (June 3 local elections)?" Song added, "My view is that it's better not to create unnecessary political controversy by having the special counsel reveal the fabricated case, indict it, and then send it to the prosecution once the findings are finalized, so the prosecution can resolve it from a standpoint of taking responsibility for its own mistakes." <<> In contrast, Candidate Jung replied, "This is an issue that should be decided again after surveying party members' opinions," adding, "We need to follow the will of the people and party members well." Jung also noted, "Regarding the cancellation of the fabricated indictment, former commander Lim Seong-geun already sought a ruling on its constitutionality, and it was deemed constitutional. So there’s no legal problem." <<> Candidate Kim said, "If an indictment was fabricated, it should be corrected in principle," and added, "Whether it’s canceled by the special counsel or voluntarily resolved by the prosecution, we can choose whichever method is efficient and aligns with public consensus." <<> The candidates also clashed over prosecution reform plans aimed at completely abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers. Jung stated, "Party members were very dissatisfied with the government's bill on the Central Investigation Bureau and Public Prosecution Office Act, but I took the lead in revising it satisfactorily," adding, "By carrying out prosecution reform well, I believe traditional supporters will trust the Democratic Party's reform efforts and rally for the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and to boost the party's approval rating." <<> In response, Kim asked, "Are you saying the president and government, who advocate for abolishing supplementary investigative powers, lack a reformist spirit?" He reiterated his claim that, during his time as Prime Minister in May, he conveyed his position to the party that the prosecution reform plan should proceed based on the full abolition of supplementary investigative powers, but the party rejected it. <<> To this, Jung retorted, "Candidate Kim says he requested the full abolition of supplementary investigative powers and prosecution reform in May, but don't we need legislation? He claims he requested it from the party, but bypassing the party leader and floor leader is not a request to the party." Kim fired back, "I have never once bypassed the leaders in party-government consultations," adding, "This is the essence of the so-called 'Myung-Jeong' conflict and party-government strife. As writer Yoo Si-min has pointed out, Candidate Jung continues to make statements that cast doubt on the president's and government's commitment to prosecution reform." <<> The tension between Candidates Kim and Jung also extended to the issue of the Prosecution Reform Promotion Team under the Prime Minister's Office not having presented a government proposal. <<> Jung remarked, "They paid 1.7 billion won to a law school professor for research services. If no deliverables were produced, they should refund the 1.7 billion won." Kim countered, "Of that 1.7 billion won, about 500 million won was actually used, and given that this involved establishing the Central Investigation Bureau and Public Prosecution Office, discussions on supplementary investigative powers were only a partial aspect." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 대표 선거에 출마한 송영길·정청래·김민석 후보(기호순)가 지난 4월 민주당이 추진하려다 지방선거 뒤로 미뤄둔 조작기소 특검법에 공소취소 권한을 부여하는 문제에 대해 이견을 보였다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: “Silence on Yoo Si-min’s curse, can that person be party leader?”… Jeong Cheong-rae: “Stop the crucifix-trampling act” (김민석 “유시민 저주에 침묵, 당대표 가능하냐”…정청래 “십자가 밟기 말라”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil and Kim Min-seok, candidates in the Democratic Party of Korea’s party leadership race, launched a joint attack on Jeong Cheong-rae over the blame for the defeat in the June 1 local elections. Jeong countered, “Statistically, it was a winning election.” Kim and Jeong also engaged in sharp verbal exchanges over the “birthday vote” strategy employed by candidates for the Supreme Council aligned with Jeong. <<> At the first televised debate for party leadership candidates held at MBC in Mapo-gu, Seoul on the 29th, Song asked Jeong, “Unlike the situation during Rep. Lee Jae-myung’s tenure, we’re not even in opposition now, nor in a dire situation facing prosecution persecution. What’s the reason for insisting on a second term?” He also questioned, “Regarding the assessment of the local elections, there’s a significant gap between your view and the president’s or other candidates’. Is the president wrong?” <<> Jeong responded, “I think I could do better if given another chance. That’s for party members and the public to judge, and my approval rating isn’t that low.” He added, “On June 4, the day after the local elections, the party, government, and presidential office coordinated to state the party leader’s position. I believed that the moment we defined the result as a defeat, the entire first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the party would be branded a failure.” <<> Kim and Jeong continued their tug-of-war over the election results. <<> Kim emphasized that, having served as general election headquarters chief and election committee chair, he had won the parliamentary, presidential, and local elections. He directly criticized Jeong: “During your tenure, you made a verbal slip in the Busan election and mishandled the stance on Pyeongtaek, barely visiting those campaign sites. You have limitations in election leadership—would a second term as party leader really solve that?” Jeong retorted, “You seem unaware because you’ve never been party leader. Election leadership isn’t something staff handle.” Kim pointed out, “You took on the party leadership without ever holding a party post like general headquarters chief, and you failed to lead important elections to victory.” <<> Meanwhile, Kim and Jeong also clashed over the “birthday vote” strategy of Supreme Council candidates aligned with Jeong. <<> Kim argued, “Jeong is leading the most old-fashioned factional politics. Having some Supreme Council candidates do birthday-matching or odd-even voting is an openly crude form of old-school politics I’ve never seen before.” He added, “The only common thread among those three candidates might be that no one is sure if they’re truly pro-Lee Jae-myung.” Kim also claimed, “Faction-based campaigning is illegal.” <<> Jeong responded, “It’s a voluntary act by party members—I didn’t order it, and I can’t stop it. There’s no need to get worked up.” He added, “Kim is trailing around with more Supreme Council candidates,” and “Kim made a comment about taking down those close to Jeong Cheong-rae—that’s old-school politics.” <<> At the debate, there was also an offensive over remarks by writer Yoo Si-min, which had caused a stir in the Democratic camp. Kim pointed out that Jeong had given a “no comment” on Yoo’s “Lee Jae-myung government is doomed to fail” thesis, asking, “He insulted the party, the nation, and the president with almost a curse, yet in that situation, can a party leader who can’t say a single word be possible?” Jeong replied, “I’d prefer you not trample on the cross.” He added, “I hope we don’t play the game where insulting someone makes you pro-Lee, and not insulting makes you something else. Isn’t that too cruel?” <<> By Koh Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길·김민석 후보가 지난 6·3 지방선거 패배의 책임론을 두고 정청래 후보를 협공했다. 정 후보는 “수치상으로는 이긴 선거”라고 맞받았다. 김 후보와 정 후보는 정 후보 쪽 최고위원 후보들의 ‘생일투표’ 전략 등을 놓고도 날 선 설전을 벌였다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Korea-Chile FTA Must Evolve”… Also Signs Mineral Resources MOU (이 대통령 “한·칠레 FTA 진화해야”… 광물 자원 MOU도 체결)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, stated on the 29th (local time), “The Korea-Chile Free Trade Agreement (FTA) must evolve to reflect new realities.” (칠레를 공식 방문한 이재명 대통령이 29일(현지시각) “한·칠레간 자유무역협정(FTA)가 새로운 현실을 반영하도록 진화해야 한다”고 말했다.)

According to the Argentine media outlet ‘Infobae’, President Lee said in a written interview with EFE news agency published before his visit to Chile, “Today’s economy is being restructured around digital trade, artificial intelligence (AI), clean technology, resilient supply chains, and the transition to carbon neutrality.” The Korea-Chile FTA, which took effect in 2004, is Korea’s first FTA. ( 아르헨티나 언론 ‘인포바에'에 따르면 이 대통령은 칠레 방문에 앞서 공개된 이에프이(EFE) 통신과의 서면 인터뷰에서 “오늘날 경제는 디지털 무역, 인공지능(AI), 청정기술, 회복력 있는 공급망, 탄소 중립 전환을 중심으로 재편되고 있다”며 이렇게 말했다. 2004년 발효된 한·칠레 에프티에이는 우리나라 최초의 에프티에이다.)

President Lee emphasized the agreement’s important role in diplomatic relations, stating that it must be adjusted to reflect the “dramatic changes” that have occurred since then. To this end, President Lee said the two countries should resume the FTA Free Trade Commission and advance discussions on modernizing the agreement. ( 이 대통령은 이 협정이 외교관계에서 중요한 역할을 했음을 강조하며, 협정이 그 후에 발생한 “극적인 변화”에 맞춰 조정돼야 한다고 말했다. 이를 위해 이 대통령은 양국이 에프티에이 자유무역위원회를 재개하고, 협정 현대화에 대한 논의를 진전시켜야 한다고 말했다.)

President Lee stressed that the modernization of the agreement aims not only to revise trade norms but also to create business opportunities, support innovation, and strengthen cooperation in new industries. He added that the modernization should also include labor standards and gender equality. ( 이 대통령은 이번 협정 현대화가 단순히 무역 규범을 개정하는 데 그치는 게 아니라 비즈니스 기회를 창출하고 혁신을 지원하며 신산업 분야의 협력을 강화하는 데 목적이 있다고 강조했다. 그러면서 협정 현대화를 통해 노동 기준 및 성평등 분야도 포함돼야 한다고 덧붙였다.)

Furthermore, he announced that the two countries would sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on mineral resources partnership during the official visit. “The goal is to cooperate in stabilizing the global supply chain for critical minerals,” President Lee said. “Chile holds the world’s largest reserves of lithium and copper, and Korea is a country with stable demand and an advanced industrial base.” Chile’s copper and lithium reserves are the largest in the world. President Lee added, “These strengths will serve as a foundation for forming a competitive value chain, from mineral development and processing to advanced manufacturing.” ( 아울러 이번 공식 방문 동안 양국은 광물 자원 파트너십 양해각서(MOU)도 체결할 것이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “목표는 핵심 광물의 글로벌 공급망을 안정화하기 위해 협력하는 것”이라며 “칠레는 세계 최대 규모의 리튬 및 구리 매장량을 보유하고 있고, 한국은 안정적인 수요와 첨단 산업 기반을 갖춘 국가”라고 말했다. 칠레의 구리·리튬 매장량은 세계 1위다. 이 대통령은 “이러한 강점들이 광물 개발 및 가공부터 첨단 제조에 이르기까지 경쟁력 있는 가치사슬을 형성하는 발판이 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee arrived in Santiago, the capital of Chile, on this day after concluding a four-day state visit to Brazil. After holding a dinner meeting with overseas Koreans on the evening of this day, President Lee is scheduled to hold a summit with President José Antonio Kast on the 30th. ( 한편 이 대통령은 이날 3박4일간 브라질 국빈 방문을 마무리하고 칠레의 수도 산티아고에 도착했다. 이 대통령은 이날 저녁 동포 만찬 간담회를 연 뒤 30일에는 호세 안토니오 카스트 대통령과 정상회담을 할 예정이다. )

Santiago/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 산티아고/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Meets Korean Residents in Chile: "Korea's First FTA Partner... A Precious Companion" (이 대통령, 칠레 동포 만나 “한국 첫 FTA 파트너…소중한 동반자”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, said on the 29th (local time), "Chile not only recognized the Republic of Korea government first among Latin American countries in 1949, the year after the establishment of the ROK government, but it is also Korea's first free trade agreement (FTA) partner." (칠레를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 29일(현지시각) “칠레는 대한민국 정부 수립 이듬해인 1949년 중남미 국가 중에서 제일 처음으로 대한민국 정부를 승인해줬을 뿐 아니라 대한민국 최초의 자유무역협정(FTA) 파트너”라고 말했다.)

At a dinner meeting with Korean residents held at a hotel in Santiago, the capital of Chile, the President emphasized the ties between the two countries, saying, "At a time when the world knew little about Korea, Chile was a grateful nation that first recognized our potential and extended a hand. When Korea began to open its economic doors to the world, Chile became our precious companion." (이 대통령은 이날 칠레 수도 산티아고의 한 호텔에서 열린 동포 만찬 간담회에서 “전 세계가 대한민국에 대해서 잘 알지 못했던 시절에 우리의 가능성을 먼저 알아보고 손을 내밀어 준 고마운 나라”라며 “대한민국이 또 세계를 향해 경제의 문을 넓히기 시작했을 때 칠레가 우리의 소중한 동반자가 되어 주었던 것”이라며 양국의 인연을 강조했다.)

The President then said, "Our Korean residents, even amid major earthquakes and social turmoil, collected donations and contributed to recovery efforts for Chilean neighbors who suffered greater damage," adding, "I am truly proud of you, our Korean residents, who have never let go of each other's hands over more than half a century and have elevated the stature of the Republic of Korea through constant effort and dedication." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “우리 동포들은 대지진과 사회적 혼란 속에서도 더 큰 피해를 입은 칠레 이웃들을 위해 성금을 모으고 복구에 힘을 보태셨다”며 “반세기 넘는 오랜 세월 동안 서로의 손을 놓지 않으며 부단한 노력과 헌신을 통해 우리 대한민국의 위상을 높여온 동포 여러분이 참으로 자랑스럽다”고 말했다.)

The President continued, "I will provide thorough support so that the next generations, who will carry on the future of the Korean community, can take pride in their Korean roots and pursue greater dreams," and "I will strengthen policies and consular services for Korean residents that protect your safety and rights and are practically tangible." (이 대통령은 이어 “동포사회의 미래를 이어갈 차세대들이 한국인이라는 뿌리에 자부심을 가지고 더 큰 꿈을 펼칠 수 있도록 빈틈없이 뒷받침하겠다”며 “동포 여러분의 안전과 권익을 지키고 실질적으로 체감할 수 있는 동포 정책과 영사 서비스를 강화해 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Santiago/Seo Young-ji reporter yj@hani.co.kr (산티아고/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Appoints Two Additional Ethics Committee Members... Woo Jae-jun Objects: "First Investigate Biased Operations" (국힘, 윤리위원 2명 추가 임명…우재준 “편향적 운영 조사부터 해야” 반발)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) appointed two additional members to its Central Ethics Committee on the 30th. During the party's Supreme Council meeting that day, there were also voices opposing the additional appointments, calling for an internal investigation into the biased operations of the Ethics Committee, recently highlighted by complaints from Chairman Yoon Min-woo and others. (국민의힘이 30일 당 중앙윤리위원회 윤리위원 2명을 추가 임명했다. 이날 당 최고위원회의에서는 윤리위원 추가 임명에 반대하며 최근 윤리위 내부에서 표출된 윤민우 위원장 등의 편향적 운영에 대한 자체 조사가 필요하다는 목소리도 나왔다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly that morning, "The appointment of two additional members to the Central Ethics Committee was approved by the Supreme Council." Choi said, "There were previously two resignations from the Ethics Committee. The reason was reported to be that the real names of Central Ethics Committee members were disclosed to the media, leading to pressure and burden, prompting their resignations. Considering those resignations, we appointed two additional members." (최보윤 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 최고위원회 회의 직후 기자들과 만나 “중앙윤리위원회 윤리위원 2인 임명이 최고위에서 의결됐다”고 말했다. 최 수석대변인은 “과거 윤리위원 2인 사임이 있었다. 그 이유는 중앙윤리위원 실명 명단이 언론에 공개됐고 이에 대해 압박과 부담을 느껴서 사의 표명한 것으로 밝혀져 있다. 사임을 고려해서 추가 2인을 임명했다”고 말했다.)

Choi added, "At the Supreme Council meeting today, there was strong criticism from a majority of Supreme Council members over the repeated leakage of the Ethics Committee member list," and "There were also remarks that the behavior of some Ethics Committee members, which disrupts the Committee's operations, is undesirable." (최 수석대변인은 이어 “최고위에서 오늘 윤리위원 명단이 반복적으로 유출되는 점에서 최고위원 다수의 강력한 문제 제기가 있었다”며 “또 윤리위원회를 파행시키는 윤리위원의 행태가 바람직하지 않다는 말씀도 있었다”고 전했다.)

In this process, Supreme Council member Woo Jae-jun openly expressed his opposition. Woo told reporters in front of the meeting room, "I opposed (the additional appointments) because I cannot agree with the approach of simply filling the vacancies left by those who resigned to push forward the Ethics Committee's operations." He also said, "We need to investigate what is happening in the Ethics Committee and whether it is truly being run in a biased manner," adding, "(The party leader) said he has no authority to investigate." (이 과정에서 우재준 최고위원은 반대 의견을 냈다고 공개적으로 밝혔다. 우 최고위원은 회의실 앞에서 기자들과 만나 “사퇴한 사람들의 자리 공백을 막 메워서 윤리위를 강행하겠다는 이런 식의 기조에 대해서는 동의할 수 없다는 취지에서 (윤리위원 추가 임명에) 반대했다”고 말했다. 그는 또 “윤리위에서 어떤 일이 일어나고 있는지, 진짜 편향적으로 운영되고 있는 게 아닌지 등에 대해서 조사를 해야 하는 상황”이라며 “(당 대표는) 조사할 권한이 없다(고 말했다)”고 전했다.)

Regarding the investigation of the Ethics Committee, Choi explained, "For non-party members (some Ethics Committee members), the party constitution and rules do not grant authority to investigate, making it impossible." (최 수석대변인은 이에 대해 윤리위 조사와 관련해 “비당원(일부 윤리위원)에 대해서는 조사할 권한이 당헌 당규상 없어서 불가능하다”고 설명했다. )

Recently, two members of the PPP's Central Ethics Committee resigned in succession, reducing the committee's size from seven to five members. This has raised concerns within the party about the fairness and representativeness of the Ethics Committee's operations. (최근 국민의힘 중앙윤리위원 2명이 잇달아 사임하면서 윤리위원 수는 7명에서 5명으로 줄었다. 이에 당내에서 윤리위 운영의 공정성과 대표성을 우려하는 목소리가 나온 바 있다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok’s ‘Suitability as Democratic Party Leader’ Within Margin of Error Among Both General Public and Supporters [NBS] (정청래·김민석 ‘민주당 대표 적합도’, 국민도 지지층도 오차범위 내 [NBS])
item.description:
A poll released on the 30th shows that in a survey on suitability for the next leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, candidate Jeong Cheong-rae received 21% and candidate Kim Min-seok received 19%, indicating a close race within the margin of error. (차기 더불어민주당 대표 적합도 조사에서 정청래 후보가 21%, 김민석 후보가 19%를 기록해 오차범위 내 접전이라는 여론조사 결과가 30일 나왔다.)

According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) results published this day by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research (a telephone interview survey with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), in terms of suitability for the next party leader of the Democratic Party, candidate Jeong received 21%, candidate Kim 19%, and candidate Song Young-gil 6%. However, more than half of the respondents (54%) answered 'undecided (don't know/no response).' (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 이날 발표한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(전화면접조사, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트)를 보면, 민주당 차기 당대표 적합도에서 정 후보가 21%, 김 후보 19%, 송영길 후보 6%를 얻었다. 다만 응답자 절반 이상(54%)가 ‘태도 유보(모름·무응답)’이라고 답했다.)

Among Democratic Party supporters, candidate Kim received 34%, candidate Jeong 29%, and candidate Song 9%. (민주당 지지층에서는 김 후보 34%, 정 후보 29%, 송 후보 9%로 나타났다.)

The positive evaluation of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs management stood at 53%. In the survey two weeks ago (July 13–15), it was 55%. The negative evaluation rose from 34% two weeks ago to 37% this week. (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정평가는 53%였다. 2주 전(7월13∼15일) 조사에선 55%였다. 부정평가는 2주 전 34%에서 이번 주 37%였다.)

Party approval ratings showed the Democratic Party at 40% and the People Power Party at 21%. Two weeks ago, the Democratic Party had 38% and the People Power Party 22%. The Rebuilding Korea Party and the Reform Party each recorded 2%, the Progressive Party 1%, and the undecided group was 33%. (정당 지지도는 민주당 40%, 국민의힘 21%로 나타났다. 2주 전에는 민주당 38%, 국민의힘 22%였다. 조국혁신당과 개혁신당은 각각 2%, 진보당 1%로 집계됐고, 태도유보층이 33%였다.)

Regarding the government's real estate policy evaluation, 56% of respondents said it is 'doing poorly,' while 33% said it is 'doing well.' Compared to the survey in January, positive evaluations decreased by 2 percentage points, and negative evaluations increased by 9 percentage points. (정부 부동산정책 평가와 관련해서는 ‘잘못하고 있다’는 응답이 56%, ‘잘하고 있다’는 답변이 33%였다. 지난 1월 조사와 비교했을 때 긍정 평가는 2%포인트 줄었고, 부정 평가는 9%포인트 늘어난 수치다.)

This survey was conducted from the 27th to the 29th targeting 1,000 citizens aged 18 and older. For more details, refer to the website of the Central Election Poll Review Committee. (이번 조사는 지난 27∼29일 만 18살 이상 국민 1000명을 대상으로 진행됐다. 자세한 내용은 중앙여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참고하면 된다.)

item.title: Opposition lawmakers counter People Power Party’s attack on “President Lee” by stating “Dismissal of indictment is not a new system” at Legislation and Judiciary Committee (이 대통령 공격 국힘에 “공소기각 새 제도 아냐” 법사위 내 반박)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the Democratic Party, the Rebuilding Korea Party, and the Progressive Party, all members of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, stated on the 30th, “Dismissal of an indictment is not a newly created system” and “This revision clearly reflects in law the legal principles established by the Supreme Court.” This serves as a rebuttal to the People Power Party’s offensive, which claimed that the Criminal Procedure Act amendment passed by the committee the previous day included a provision expanding the grounds for court dismissal of indictments, alleging it was “aimed at canceling President Lee Jae-myung’s trial.” <<> Democratic Party lawmakers Seo Young-kyo, Kim Seung-won, Lee Seong-yoon, and Kim Yong-min, along with Rebuilding Korea Party lawmaker Park Eun-jung and Progressive Party lawmaker Son Sol, held a press conference at the National Assembly’s Communication Center that morning, stating, “The People Power Party is pushing false narratives without even properly reviewing the bill.” They urged, “If the People Power Party truly cares for the people, it should actively participate in the normalization of the criminal justice system, which is happening for the first time in 70 years.” <<> They cited the Supreme Court’s 2008 ruling on dismissal of indictment (involving police entrapment in a karaoke hostess referral business) and its 2021 ruling (involving prosecutorial retaliatory indictment against Yoo Woo-sung, a victim of the Seoul city spy fabrication case), stating, “These Supreme Court precedents were incorporated into the amendment bill co-sponsored by lawmakers Kim Yong-min and Park Eun-jung, which underwent five full committee meetings and nine subcommittee reviews.” They added, “Yet the People Power Party is distorting this as a ‘midnight insertion,’ which is nothing more than a political offensive ignoring the facts.” <<> In response to questions about why the provision expanding grounds for dismissal of indictment was not included in the Democratic Party’s own Criminal Procedure Act reform task force bill adopted as party policy, Democratic Party committee secretary Kim Seung-won said, “The party policy focuses on separating investigation and prosecution as its core element, and this part (dismissal of indictment) is not of a nature to be included in the party policy.” Committee chair Seo Young-kyo dismissed concerns that the provision might affect President Lee’s currently suspended trial, calling it “nonsense.” <<> The People Power Party continues to push back. Floor leader Chung Jin-suk stated at a Supreme Council meeting that day, “(The Democratic Party) has added another poison clause to the Criminal Procedure Act amendment,” claiming, “They intend to establish a dismissal of indictment court, akin to a second season of a special counsel for dismissal, to cancel President Lee’s criminal trial.” <<> Chung further alleged, “This is a political behind-the-scenes deal between a president trying to eliminate his own criminal trial and the hardliners of the Democratic Party seeking to abolish the prosecution.” <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 더불어민주당과 조국혁신당·진보당 의원들이 30일 “공소기각은 새로 만든 제도가 아니다”라며 “이번 개정은 대법원이 확립한 법리를 법률에 명확히 반영한 것”이라고 밝혔다. 국민의힘이 전날 법사위 전체회의를 통과한 형사소송법 개정안에 법원의 공소기각 사유를 확대한 조항이 들어가자 “이재명 대통령의 재판을 취소하기 위한 것”이라고 공세를 편 데 대한 반박이다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Agree on Scope of Investigation for 'Election Commission Special Counsel Bill'…To Be Processed at Afternoon Plenary Session (여야, ‘선관위 특검법안’ 수사 범위 합의…오후 본회의 처리)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties agreed on the details of the special counsel bill regarding the National Election Commission's June 3 ballot shortage incident on the 30th. The bill is expected to be presented and processed at the afternoon plenary session. (여야가 30일 6·3 투표용지 부족 사태에 대한 선거관리위원회 특검법안의 세부 내용에 대해 합의했다. 이날 오후 본회의에 특검법을 상정해 처리할 예정이다.)

Han Byeong-do, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and floor leader, along with Cheon Jun-ho, deputy floor leader for legislative affairs, and Jeong Jeom-sik, floor leader of the People Power Party, along with Kim Seung-su, deputy floor leader for legislative affairs, reached this agreement during a meeting at the National Assembly. (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표·천준호 원내운영수석부대표와 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표·김승수 원내운영수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 회동하고 이같이 합의했다.)

According to the agreement between the parties, the official name of the special counsel bill was set as the 'Act on the Appointment of a Special Prosecutor for Investigating Allegations of Infringement on Citizens' Political Rights, Including the Ballot Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Local Elections.' (여야 합의문을 보면, 특검법안 명칭은 ‘제9회 전국동시 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 의혹 진상 규명을 위한 특별검사의 임명 등에 관한 법률안’으로 정했다.)

The key point of contention—the scope and subjects of the special counsel's investigation—includes: △ incidents involving allegations of infringement on citizens' exercise of political rights, and △ cases of alleged election management system data entry errors, such as manipulation of voter turnout statistics, and election statistics manipulation. (핵심 쟁점이던 특검의 수사 대상과 범위는 △국민의 참정권 행사가 침해됐다는 의혹 사건 △투표율 집계 조작 등 선거관리 시스템 전산 입력 오류 및 선거 통계 조작 의혹 사건 등이 포함됐다.)

The ruling and opposition parties plan to finalize the bill's legislative drafting and then process it through the Legislation and Judiciary Committee before handling it at the plenary session. (여야는 법안 조문화 작업이 완성되는 대로 법제사법위원회 심사를 거쳐 본회의에서 법안을 처리할 방침이다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, the parties had agreed to form a National Recommendation Committee to appoint a special counsel for the Election Commission. The committee will receive three nominations each from the Korean Bar Association and the Association of Law Schools, select two through bipartisan agreement to recommend to the president, who will then appoint one of the two as the special prosecutor. item.title: Current Affairs Commentator Lee Seung-won Appointed as Cheong Wa Dae's Secretary for Foreign Press (청와대 해외언론비서관에 시사평론가 이승원씨 내정)
item.description:
Lee Seung-won, a former adjunct professor at Hanyang University's Graduate School of Education and a journalist-turned-current affairs commentator, has been appointed as Cheong Wa Dae's Secretary for Foreign Press. (청와대 해외언론비서관에 언론인 출신 시사평론가인 이승원 전 한양대 교육대학원 겸임교수가 내정됐다.)

According to a report by The Hankyoreh on the 30th, Lee will begin his role as Secretary for Foreign Press at Cheong Wa Dae starting the 31st. A former reporter for Edaily and Naeil Shinmun, Lee transitioned to a full-time current affairs commentator in 2013 and has since hosted various radio and television programs. The previous secretary, Choi Seong-ah, resigned for personal reasons. (30일 한겨레 취재에 따르면, 이 전 교수는 31일부터 청와대 해외언론비서관으로 출근한다. 이 전 교수는 이데일리와 내일신문 기자 출신으로 2013년 시사평론가로 전업한 뒤 여러 라디오·방송 프로그램 등을 진행해왔다. 최성아 해외언론비서관은 개인 사유로 사의를 표명했다.)

Additionally, Kim Rak-joong, a senior administrative officer in the Office of the Secretary for National Agenda, has been appointed as the successor to Han Sang-ik, the Secretary for National Agenda, and is expected to begin his duties on the 31st. Kim, who previously worked for a local media outlet in Seongnam, joined as a secretary when President Lee Jae-myung was mayor of Seongnam and later served as a policy advisor for Gyeonggi Province. Cheong Wa Dae reportedly carried out a promotion of around 60 administrative officers, including Kim, on the 24th. (또 한상익 국정과제비서관의 후임으로는 김락중 국정과제비서관실 선임행정관이 내정돼 31일부터 업무를 수행하는 것으로 전해졌다. 김 행정관은 성남 지역 언론사 출신으로 이재명 대통령이 성남시장일 때 비서관으로 합류했고 이후 경기도 정책보좌관 등을 지냈다. 청와대는 김 비서관을 포함해 지난 24일 60여명 규모의 행정관 승진 인사를 단행한 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: National Assembly Passes 'Election Commission Special Counsel Act'… Bipartisan Agreement (‘선관위 특검법’ 국회 본회의 의결…여야 합의)
item.description:
The National Assembly convened a plenary session on the 30th and passed a bill on the appointment of a special counsel to investigate allegations of infringement of citizens' right to participate, including the shortage of ballots for the 9th nationwide simultaneous local elections, which was prepared through bipartisan agreement (Election Commission Special Counsel Act). (국회는 30일 본회의를 열어 여야 합의로 마련된 제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민참정권 침해 의혹 진상규명을 위한 특별검사의 임명 등에 관한 법률안(선관위 특검법)을 의결했다.)

The scope and targets of the special counsel investigation include: △alleged incidents where citizens' exercise of their right to participate was infringed; △alleged incidents where vote counting was forced without suspension or preservation measures after allegations of poor ballot management emerged; △alleged cases of procedural violations and abuse of authority, such as the reduction of the lower limit for the quantity of official ballots printed by the National Election Commission; △and alleged incidents of manipulation of voter turnout statistics, errors in the election management system's electronic data entry, and election statistics manipulation. (특검 수사 대상과 범위는 △국민의 참정권 행사가 침해됐다는 의혹 사건 △투표과정 부실 관리 의혹 발생 이후 개표 중단·보전 조치 없이 개표를 강행한 의혹 사건 △선거관리위원회의 본투표용지 인쇄 물량 하한 기준 축소 등 절차적 위법 및 직권남용 등 혐의 사건 △투표율 집계 조작 등 선거관리 시스템 전산 입력 오류 및 선거 통계 조작 의혹 사건 등이다.)

The special counsel investigation also covers the overall operations of the Election Commission, including overseas junkets by former and current commissioners and related personnel, unfair or preferential hiring, non-competitive contracts, and collusion with vendors. (선관위 전·현직 위원 및 관계자의 외유성 출장, 부정·특혜 채용, 수의계약·업체 유착 등 기관 운영 전반도 특검 수사 대상이다.)

item.title: ‘Special Counsel Act on Election Commission’ Passes National Assembly… 2.47 Million Ballot Papers in Jamsil to be Recounted (‘선관위 특검법’ 국회 통과…잠실 투표지 247만장 재검표 한다)
item.description:
On the 30th, the National Assembly passed the special counsel act for the Election Commission, aimed at uncovering the truth behind the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections, with agreement from both ruling and opposition parties. On the same day, the two parties extended the activities of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the Election Commission’s parliamentary investigation by 30 days. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 진상 규명을 위한 선거관리위원회 특별검사법이 30일 여야 합의로 국회 본회의를 통과했다. 여야는 이날 선관위 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위) 활동기간을 30일간 연장했다.)

The National Assembly held a plenary session that afternoon and passed the “Act on the Appointment of a Special Counsel for Investigating Allegations of Infringement on Citizens’ Right to Participate, Including the Ballot Paper Shortage in the 9th Nationwide Concurrent Local Elections” with 226 votes in favor and 2 against out of 228 attending lawmakers. (국회는 이날 오후 본회의를 열고 재석 의원 228명 가운데 찬성 226표, 반대 2표로 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민참정권 침해 의혹 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안’(선관위 특검법)을 가결했다.)

According to the special counsel act, the investigative team will consist of up to 5 special counsel assistants, 70 special investigators, up to 20 dispatched prosecutors, and up to 70 dispatched public officials excluding the prosecutors. The special counsel can prepare for the task within 20 days of appointment and must complete the investigation within 90 days from the day after the preparation period ends, determining whether to press charges. If necessary, the investigation period can be extended twice by 30 days each, allowing activities for up to 150 days. Including the preparation period, the investigation can last up to 170 days. (특검법을 보면 수사 인력은 특검보 5명, 특별수사관 70명, 파견검사 20명 이내, 파견검사를 제외한 파견공무원 70명 이내로 했다. 특검은 임명된 날로부터 20일 이내에 직무수행에 필요한 준비를 할 수 있고, 준비기간 만료 다음 날부터 90일 이내에 수사를 완료하고 공소제기 여부를 결정해야 한다. 필요한 경우 2회에 걸쳐 각 30일씩 수사 기간을 연장해 최장 150일 활동할 수 있다. 준비기간을 포함하면 최장 170일 수사가 가능하다. )

The scope of the investigation, which was a key issue, includes: allegations that citizens’ right to participate was violated due to the shortage of ballot papers; allegations of computational errors in the election management system, such as manipulation of voter turnout tallies and election statistics; and cases identified during the investigation of the target incidents. (핵심 쟁점이었던 수사 대상에는 △투표용지 부족으로 국민 참정권 행사가 침해된 의혹 △투표율 집계 조작 등 선거관리 시스템 전산 입력 오류·선거 통계 조작 의혹 △수사 대상 사건 관련 수사 과정에서 인지된 사건 등이 포함됐다.)

The ruling and opposition parties had been at odds over the scope and targets of the investigation until the previous day, but before the plenary session, Han Byeong-do of the Democratic Party and Jeong Jeom-sik of the People Power Party, both floor leaders, reached an agreement on the special counsel act for the Election Commission that morning. (여야는 수사 대상과 범위를 두고 전날까지 평행선을 달렸지만, 본회의에 앞서 한병도 더불어민주당·정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 오전 선관위 특검법 처리에 합의했다.)

Previously, on the 21st, the parties had agreed to recommend the special counsel through a national recommendation committee. The committee will receive three candidates each from both parties, recommended by the Korean Bar Association and the Council of Law School Deans, and then recommend two candidates to the president by consensus. The president will appoint one of them as the special counsel. (앞서 여야는 지난 21일 특검 추천 방식에 대해선 국민추천위원회를 통해 특검을 추천하기로 합의한 바 있다. 국민추천위는 대한변호사협회와 법학전문대학원협의회로부터 여야가 각각 특검 후보 3명씩을 추천받은 뒤 이 중 2명을 여야 합의로 대통령에게 추천하며, 대통령은 그중 1명을 특검으로 임명하도록 했다.)

Meanwhile, the plenary session also passed a motion to extend the activities of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the Election Commission’s parliamentary investigation, which was set to end on the 1st of next month, by 30 days until the 30th of next month. The special committee plans to hold a third hearing on the 10th of next month and proceed with an on-site verification of the recount of 2.47 million ballot papers stored at the ballot counting station in Songpa District on the 18th. (한편 이날 본회의에서 다음달 1일로 활동 기한이 종료되는 선관위 국조특위 활동 기간을 다음달 30일까지 30일 연장하는 안건도 의결했다. 국조특위는 다음달 10일 제3차 청문회를 열고, 18일 247만장의 투표지가 보관된 송파구 개표소 재검표 현장 검증을 추진하기로 했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling Party's Internal Strife Continues… Supreme Council 'Cracks' Over Additional Appointment of 2 Ethics Committee Members (국힘 내홍 계속…윤리위원 2명 추가 임명에 최고위 내 ‘파열음’)
item.description:
The People Power Party's Supreme Council filled two vacant seats on the Central Ethics Committee on the 30th, leading to expectations that discussions on disciplinary actions against lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh will accelerate. However, internal opposition within the Supreme Council over the appointment of ethics committee members suggests the party's internal strife is ongoing. (국민의힘 최고위원회가 30일 공석이던 중앙윤리위원 2자리를 채우면서 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 논의에 속도가 붙을 거란 전망이 나온다. 윤리위원 임명을 두고 최고위 내부에서 반발이 나오는 등 당 내홍은 계속되는 모양새다.)

Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the party's Supreme Council meeting that day, "In the past, two ethics committee members resigned after their names were disclosed by the media, causing them pressure and burden. Considering this, we decided to appoint two additional members," adding, "It was to ensure the ethics committee operates smoothly." The two newly appointed members are known to be legal professionals, not party members. The ethics committee, which has a maximum capacity of nine members, had been operating with five members due to a series of resignations. Controversy over procedural legitimacy arose when a meeting attended by just three members voted to initiate disciplinary proceedings against sitting lawmakers. (최보윤 수석대변인은 이날 당 최고위원회의가 끝난 뒤 기자들을 만나 “과거 윤리위원 2명이 실명이 언론에 공개돼 압박과 부담을 느껴 사임했는데, 이를 고려해 추가 2명을 임명하게 됐다”며 “(윤리위가) 원활하게 진행하도록 선임한 것”이라고 했다. 이번에 임명된 위원 2명은 당원이 아닌 법조인으로 알려졌다. 정원이 최대 9명인 윤리위는 최근 위원들의 잇단 사퇴로 5명 체제로 운영돼왔다. 이 가운데 3명만 참석한 회의에서 현역 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 의결하면서 절차적 정당성 논란이 불거졌다.)

Cracks also emerged during the process of appointing additional ethics committee members that day. Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon objected, saying, "We are in a situation where we should investigate whether the ethics committee is being run in a biased manner, but I cannot agree with the stance of pushing ahead with the ethics committee by merely filling the vacancies left by those who resigned." However, the Supreme Council proceeded to a vote, with only Woo and Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja expressing opposition and abstention, respectively, and the appointment agenda passed with six votes in favor. Raised voices were also exchanged as Woo left his seat in protest. (이날 윤리위원 추가 임명 과정에서도 파열음이 이어졌다. 우재준 최고위원이 “윤리위가 편향적으로 운영되고 있는 게 아닌지 조사해야 하는 상황인데, 사퇴한 사람들 자리 공백만 메워서 윤리위를 강행하겠다는 기조에 동의할 수 없다”고 반발했다. 그러나 최고위는 표결에 들어갔고 우 최고위원과 양향자 최고위원만 각각 반대와 기권 의사를 밝히며 찬성 6명으로 임명 안건이 가결됐다. 우 최고위원이 반발하며 자리를 뜨는 과정에서 고성도 오갔다.)

Ethics Committee Chairman Yoon Min-woo issued a statement that day, warning, "If violations of the duty to maintain confidentiality regarding internal discussions within the ethics committee recur, I will take strict measures, such as requesting the party leader to dismiss the ethics committee member in question, in accordance with relevant regulations." This appeared to target Vice Chairman Woo Jong-hwan and Ethics Committee member Hwang Kyung-sung, who had previously issued a public statement opposing Chairman Yoon's unilateral management and boycotted the meeting. It was also reported that opinions were raised during the closed-door Supreme Council meeting that Vice Chairman Woo should be dismissed. item.title: JCS: 'Unidentified Aircraft in Northern Gyeonggi Civilian Control Zone Was US Military Drone on Training' (합참 “경기 북부 민통선 미확인 비행체는 훈련중인 미군 무인기”)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced on the afternoon of the 30th that an unidentified aircraft spotted south of the General Outpost (GOP) line in northern Gyeonggi Province was confirmed to be a US military drone. (합동참모본부(합참)는 30일 오후 경기 북부 지오피(GOP·일반전초) 이남지역에서 미확인 비행체를 식별해 확인한 결과 미군 소속 무인기로 판명됐다고 밝혔다.)

The JCS explained that soldiers in the area detected the unidentified aircraft using thermal observation device (TOD) equipment, initiated a response according to operational procedures, and concluded the situation after confirming it was a US military drone undergoing training. A JCS official said regarding the military's response, "No firing or shoot-down procedures were initiated," adding, "The drone was identified south of the GOP line." The US military drone was spotted in the vicinity of the Civilian Control Line (CCL), south of the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). ( 합참은 해당 지역 부대 장병이 열상감시(TOD) 장비로 미확인 비행체를 포착해 작전수행절차에 따라 대응에 들어갔고, 훈련 중인 미군 무인기로 확인한 뒤 상황을 종료했다고 설명했다. 합참 관계자는 군의 대응과 관련해 “발포 등 격추 절차에 들어가지 않았다”며 “해당 무인기는 지오피 이남 지역에서 식별됐다”고 말했다. 미군 무인기가 비무장지대 남쪽인 민간인통제선(민통선) 일대에서 식별됐다는 것이다. )

The DMZ is established with a total width of 4 km, extending 2 km each north and south from the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). The Southern Limit Line is located 2 km south of the MDL, with GOPs situated along it. The CCL lies south of the Southern Limit Line. ( 비무장지대는 군사분계선(휴전선)을 기준으로 남북 방향으로 각각 2㎞씩, 총 너비 4㎞에 설정돼 있다. 군사분계선에서 남쪽으로 2㎞ 떨어진 곳에 남방한계선이 있고 이를 따라 지오피들이 있다. 남방한계선 이남에 민통선이 있다.)

When asked whether the area where the US military drone was identified falls under the United Nations Command's 'No-Fly Zone' near the MDL or a zone where drone operations are restricted under the September 19 inter-Korean military agreement, the official responded, "I will check." <<> In response to inquiries about whether US Forces Korea (USFK) was conducting training in northern Gyeonggi on that day, the JCS explained, "We only confirmed on-site that it was a US military drone; we need to verify the specific flight path." The military authorities plan to check whether the US provided prior notification to South Korean forces regarding the US military drone training near the CCL, or if such notification was given but not shared internally within South Korea's military. ( 이 관계자는 미군 무인기가 식별된 지역이 유엔군사령부가 군사분계선 근처에 설정한 비행금지구역인 ‘노 플라이존'에 해당하는지, 2018년 9·19 남북 군사합의에 따라 무인기 운용이 제한되는 구역인지에 대해서는 “확인하겠다”고 밝혔다. )

Since North Korean drones violated the airspace over the Seoul metropolitan area in December 2022, South Korean military authorities have frequently conducted drone response drills in the border areas of northern Gyeonggi and Gangwon. On that day, village heads near the CCL received text messages stating, 'A drone has been identified in the Cheorwon area; urgently move to nearby shelters or outside control points.' The JCS said regarding the circumstances of sending civilian evacuation texts, "We will review the matter comprehensively and provide further explanation." ( 합참은 이날 경기 북부지역에서 주한미군이 훈련 중인지 묻자 “현장에서 미군 무인기인 것만 확인했고 구체적인 항적은 확인해 봐야 한다”고 설명했다. 군 당국은 미국이 민통선 근처에서 훈련하는 미군 무인기 관련 정보를 사전에 한국군에 알리지 않았는지, 통보가 됐는데 한국군 내부에서 공유되지 않았는지를 확인할 예정이다. )

By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter: nura@hani.co.kr ( 2022년 12월 북한 무인기의 수도권 영공 침범 이후 군 당국은 경기 북부·강원 접경 지역에서 무인기 대응 훈련을 자주 해왔다. 이날 민통선 근처 마을 이장들에게 ‘철원 지역에 무인기가 식별돼 긴급히 인근 대피호 또는 통제소 밖으로 이동해야 한다'는 내용의 문자가 발송됐다. 합참은 주민 대피 문자 발송 경위 등에 대해 “전반적으로 다시 확인한 뒤 추가로 설명하겠다”고 밝혔다. )

item.title: "US-Saudi Nuclear Agreement Could Be an Opportunity for Korea to Introduce Enrichment" (“미-사우디 원자력 협정, 한국 농축 도입에 기회 요인 될 것”)
item.description:
An analysis suggests that the nuclear cooperation agreement between the United States and Saudi Arabia could serve as an opportunity to facilitate discussions on introducing uranium enrichment for South Korea in the ongoing nuclear negotiations between South Korea and the U.S. (미국과 사우디아라비아가 맺은 원자력 협력 협정이 한·미가 논의 중인 원자력 협상에서 한국의 농축 도입 논의를 촉진하는 데 기회 요인이 될 수 있다는 분석이 나왔다.)

In a report titled "Trump's Permission for Saudi Enrichment and Its Impact and Implications on South Korea's Introduction of Enrichment," released on the 29th by the Sejong Institute, Visiting Research Fellow Jeon Bong-geun stated, "(The Saudi agreement) confirms that U.S. cooperation on enrichment is not an absolute taboo," adding, "The logic that the U.S. tries to confine South Korea's enrichment demands to the realm of taboo is inevitably weakened." ( 세종연구소가 지난 29일 낸 전봉근 세종연구소 객원연구위원의 ‘트럼프의 사우디 농축 허용이 한국의 농축 도입에 미칠 영향과 시사점’ 보고서는 “(사우디 협정은) 미국의 농축 협력이 절대적인 금기가 아니라는 점을 확인했다는 데 있다”며 “미국이 한국의 농축 요구를 금기의 영역에 묶어두려는 논리는 약화될 수밖에 없다”고 했다. )

The nuclear cooperation agreement signed between the U.S. and Saudi Arabia on the 22nd (local time) in Washington, D.C., is evaluated to have paved the way for Saudi Arabia to conduct uranium enrichment, albeit with the precondition that feasibility must be proven through a two-year joint study by both countries. Instead of signing a separate safeguards agreement with the U.S., Saudi Arabia was exempted from the Additional Protocol for inspections by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). Research Fellow Jeon noted, "South Korea has incomparably better performance and capabilities than Saudi Arabia in nuclear power plant operation and export, nuclear fuel manufacturing, safety regulation and export control, and implementation of IAEA safeguards," and added, "It could use the Saudi agreement case as a negotiation asset to promote discussions on introducing enrichment." ( 앞서 미국과 사우디가 지난 22일(현지시각) 미국 워싱턴에서 맺은 원자력 협력 협정은 ‘양국의 2년 공동 연구로 타당성을 입증해야 한다’는 전제가 있으나, 사우디에 우라늄 농축을 할 수 있는 길을 터줬다는 평가를 받는다. 사우디는 미국과 별도 안전조치협정을 맺는 대신 국제원자력기구(IAEA) 사찰을 위한 추가의정서를 면제받았다. 전 연구위원은 “한국은 원전 운영과 수출, 핵연료 제조, 안전규제와 수출통제, 국제원자력기구 안전조치 이행에서 사우디와 비교할 수 없을 정도로 양호한 실적과 역량을 갖고 있다”며 “사우디 협정 사례를 협상 자산으로 활용해 농축 도입 논의를 촉진시킬 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. )

The Saudi case also presents challenges. The report pointed out that if this agreement sparks backlash from the U.S. Congress and the non-proliferation camp, the U.S. might impose stricter conditions on South Korea's enrichment demands to prevent the spread of similar cases. ( 사우디 사례가 주는 도전 요인도 있다. 보고서는 이번 협정이 미국 의회와 비확산 진영의 반발을 부를 경우, 미국이 후속 사례의 확산을 막기 위해 한국의 농축 요구에 더 엄격한 조건을 제기할 가능성도 있다고 짚었다. )

Saudi Arabia's negotiation strategy in the context of U.S.-China competition also warrants attention. It is said that Saudi Arabia actively used the possibility of nuclear cooperation with Russia or China as a bargaining chip to secure exceptional treatment from the U.S. on enrichment and nuclear non-proliferation issues. This highlighted the risk that the U.S. could not only lose a massive nuclear power plant market but also lose information and control over Saudi Arabia's nuclear development program. ( 미중 경쟁 구도 속 사우디의 협상 전략도 유의해 볼 필요가 있다. 사우디는 미국으로부터 농축과 핵비확산 문제의 예외적 대우를 받기 위해 러시아 또는 중국과의 원자력 협력 가능성을 협상 지렛대로 적극 활용했다고 한다. 미국이 거대한 원전 시장을 잃을 뿐 아니라, 사우디 핵개발 프로그램에 대한 정보와 통제력도 잃을 수 있다는 점을 부각했다는 것이다. )

However, Research Fellow Jeon suggested, "South Korea is an ally of the U.S., a model country in the international non-proliferation regime, and a nation operating within the institutional framework of South Korea-U.S. nuclear cooperation. Rather than directly imitating Saudi-style diplomacy and negotiation tactics, enrichment negotiations should be pursued by accumulating common interests—such as stable nuclear fuel supply chains, benefits for the U.S. nuclear industry, joint technological development, and access to international markets—while maintaining a stable South Korea-U.S. alliance and non-proliferation credibility." ( 다만 전 연구위원은 “한국은 미국의 동맹국이자 국제 비확산 체제의 모범국이며, 한미 원자력 협력의 제도적 틀 안에서 움직이는 국가”라며 “사우디식 외교술과 협상술을 그대로 모방하기보다, 안정적인 한미동맹과 비확산 신뢰성을 유지하면서 핵연료 공급망의 안정, 미국 원자력 산업의 이익, 양국의 공동 기술개발과 국제시장 진출이라는 공동 이익을 축적하는 방식으로 농축 협상을 추진해야 한다”고 제안했다. )

In the long term, Research Fellow Jeon proposed that the government should manage the enrichment issue as a national agenda. He stated, "The Presidential Office and the National Security Office should take the lead, while the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and ministries related to nuclear energy, industry, and science and technology should jointly develop policies and negotiation strategies." To this end, he emphasized the need to prepare a basic law outlining the principle of peaceful use of nuclear energy and government responsibilities, as well as a non-proliferation basic law that excludes nuclear weapons development and strengthens international non-proliferation obligations and domestic implementation systems. ( 장기적으론 정부가 농축 문제를 국가 의제로 관리해야 한다는 게 전 연구위원의 제안이다. 그는 “대통령실과 국가안보실이 중심을 잡고 외교부와 원자력·에너지·산업·과학기술 관련 부처가 공동의 정책과 협상전략을 마련해야 한다“고 말했다. 이를 위해 원자력의 평화적 이용 원칙과 정부 책임을 규정하기 위한 기본법과, 핵무기 개발을 배제하고 국제 비확산 의무와 국내 이행체계를 강화하는 비확산 기본법 등을 준비할 필요가 있다. )

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr ( 장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: U.S. Ambassador Steel: "Born in Seoul, Standing Here Today… The Ironclad U.S.-ROK Alliance" (스틸 미국대사 “서울서 태어나 이 자리에…한미 철통같은 동맹”)
item.description:
New U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, Michelle Steel, stated on the 30th, "I look forward to working with Korea to ensure our ironclad alliance remains the linchpin of peace and security in the region." (미셸 스틸 신임 주한미국대사가 30일 “우리(한미)의 철통같은 동맹이 역내 평화와 안보를 지탱하는 핵심축으로 남아있도록 한국과 노력해 나가길 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

Ambassador Steel arrived at Incheon International Airport that afternoon and met with reporters in the briefing area. She greeted them in Korean, saying, "I was born in Seoul, but I stand here representing the United States. Standing here again brings a mix of emotions." She then continued in English. (스틸 대사는 이날 오후 인천국제공항을 통해 입국한 뒤 브리핑장에서 취재진과 만나 한국말로 “저는 서울에서 태어났지만 미국을 대표해 이 자리에 섰습니다. 이 자리에 다시 서니 만감이 교차합니다”라고 인사한 뒤 영어로 이렇게 말했다.)

She added, "In Gyeongju, President Donald Trump and President Lee Jae-myung opened a new chapter for our alliance. We will work together to realize President Trump’s vision for the alliance, which will be stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever." Ambassador Steel further emphasized the importance of the alliance, stating, "Our alliance was forged in war and secured by the blood of those who stood shoulder to shoulder to defend freedom. Today, the U.S.-ROK alliance is one of the strongest in the world." (이어 그는 “경주에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 이재명 대통령은 우리 동맹의 새로운 장을 열었다”며 “우리는 (한미)동맹에 대한 트럼프 대통령의 비전을 함께 실현해 나갈 것이며, (동맹은) 그 어느 때보다 더 강력하고, 안전하며, 번영할 것”이라고 말했다. 아울러 스틸 대사는 “우리 동맹은 전쟁에서 다져졌고, 자유를 수호하기 위해 어깨를 나란히 한 이들의 피를 통해 확보했다”며 “오늘 한미동맹은 세계에서 가장 강력한 동맹 중 하나”라고 한미동맹의 중요성을 거듭 강조했다.)

Ambassador Steel’s mention of Gyeongju appears to underscore the follow-up implementation of agreements, such as tariff negotiations, reached during the U.S.-ROK summit held in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province, in October of last year on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting. Going forward, Ambassador Steel is expected to play a key role in the implementation phase of agreements made by the two leaders, including U.S. investment commitments, security cooperation negotiations, and shipbuilding collaboration. Particular attention is being paid to how Ambassador Steel will communicate with the South Korean government on the issue of the Coupang personal data breach, which has been cited as a potential obstacle to bilateral cooperation. However, concerns remain that Ambassador Steel, a conservative-leaning figure with a hardline stance on North Korea and China, may clash with the Lee Jae-myung administration in conveying the demands of the Trump administration. <<> Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il said on the same day, "We expect Ambassador Steel, based on her understanding of the U.S.-ROK alliance and bilateral relations, to make meaningful contributions to strengthening the alliance and enhancing friendship between the peoples of both countries." He added, "There are many issues to collaborate on between South Korea and the U.S. at this point. Since Ambassador Steel has been appointed after a vacancy of over a year, we anticipate much more effective and close diplomatic communication between the two sides." <<> Meanwhile, outside the airport, a protest was held by a civic group opposing Ambassador Steel’s appointment. About a dozen members of the "2026 August 15 Independent Peace March Promotion Committee" held banners reading "Coupang Protector Michelle Steel, Get Out" and chanted slogans as her vehicle departed. In contrast, about a dozen individuals, believed to be YouTube streamers and members of far-right groups, waved Korean national flags and U.S. flags, welcoming Ambassador Steel’s arrival and shouting at the opposing group, leading to heated exchanges. <<> Reported by Jang Ye-ji and Park Min-hee, Senior Correspondent. Email: penj@hani.co.kr (스틸 대사의 경주 관련 언급은 지난해 10월 경북 경주에서 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC)를 계기로 열린 한미 정상회담에서 합의한 관세협상 등의 후속 이행을 강조한 것으로 보인다. 앞으로 스틸 대사는 대미투자 이행과 한미 안보 분야 협상, 조선 협력 등 양국 정상이 합의한 사안의 이행 국면에서 주요한 역할을 할 것으로 전망된다. 특히 한미 협력에 걸림돌로 꼽히는 쿠팡 개인정보 유출 사건 문제를 두고 스틸 대사가 한국 정부와 어떠한 소통을 이어갈지 주목된다. 다만 북한과 중국에 강경한 입장을 보이는 보수 성향의 스틸 대사가 트럼프 행정부의 요구를  전달하는 과정에서 이재명 정부와 갈등을 빚을 수 있다는 우려도 있다.)

item.title: [Photo] Michelle Steel, first US ambassador to South Korea under second Trump administration, arrives… Progressive groups stage surprise protest ([포토] 트럼프 2기 첫 주한미대사 미셸 스틸 입국…진보단체, 반대 기습시위)
item.description:
Michelle Steel, the first US ambassador to South Korea under the second Donald Trump administration, arrived at Incheon International Airport Terminal 2 on the 30th. (미국 도널드 트럼프 2기 행정부의 첫 주한미국대사인 미셸 스틸 대사가 30일 인천국제공항 제2터미널을 통해 입국했다.)

In her first briefing upon arriving at Incheon International Airport that afternoon, Ambassador Steel stated, "The ROK-US alliance has repeatedly proven its value based on long-standing trust and is one of the most powerful alliances in the world today." Ambassador Michelle Steel, nominated as the first Korean-American female US ambassador to South Korea, was born in Seoul in 1955 as a second-generation displaced person and is a former politician who was twice elected to the U.S. House of Representatives for California in 2020 and 2022. (스틸 대사는 이날 오후 인천국제공항으로 입국하며 가진 첫 브리핑에서 “한미동맹은 오랜 신뢰를 바탕으로 거듭 그 가치를 입증해 왔으며, 오늘날 세계에서 가장 강력한 동맹 가운데 하나”라는 입장을 밝혔다. 한국계 첫 여성 주한미국대사로 지명된 미셸 스틸 대사는 1955년 서울에서 태어난 실향민 2세로 2020년과 2022년 캘리포니아주 연방하원의원에 두 차례 당선된 정치인 출신이다.)

On this day, activists from the 'August 15 Peace March' steering committee held a press conference in front of the VIP room of Incheon Airport Terminal 2, where Ambassador Michelle Steel arrived, and stated, "We strongly reject Michelle Steel, the US ambassador to South Korea, who promotes war confrontation and interferes in internal affairs." They also claimed, "She is likely to pressure the South Korean government in economic and trade areas such as Coupang and investment in the US, and is a figure who undermines peace on the Korean Peninsula, having repeatedly stated positions such as 'South Korea should support Taiwan if war breaks out' and 'opposing the declaration of an end to the Korean War.'" As Ambassador Michelle Steel was leaving the airport, they staged a surprise protest in the event parking lot of Terminal 2, holding signs reading "Michelle Steel, leave." (이날 ‘8·15자주평화대행진’ 추진위원회 활동가들이 미셜 스틸 대사가 입국한 인천공항 제2여객터미널 귀빈실 앞에서 기자회견을 열고 “전쟁대결을 조장하고, 내정간섭을 일삼는 미셸 스틸 주한미대사를 강력히 거부한다”고 밝혔다. 또 “쿠팡, 대미투자 등 경제·통상분야에 대해 한국정부를 압박할 것으로 보이고, ‘대만 전쟁 발발시 한국이 지원해야한다’거나 ‘한반도 종전선언을 반대한다’는 입장을 여러차례 밝히는 등 한반도 평화를 저해하는 인물”이라고 주장했다. 이들은 미셸 스틸 대사가 공항을 빠져나갈 때 2터미널 행사용 주차장에서 ‘미셸 스틸 나가라’라고 적힌 손팻말을 들고 기습 시위를 벌이기도 했다.)

Park Jong-sik, reporter anaki@hani.co.kr (박종식 기자 anaki@hani.co.kr)
